run_pmap_parallel_map: run pmap to apply a function across an iterable using multiple processes with progress reporting
test_pmap_single_process: test pmap with a single process to apply a function sequentially over an iterable
build_pmap_progress_tracking: build a parallel map call with pmap that prints N of M progress updates to stdout
refactor_pmap_multiprocessing: refactor pmap to use multiprocessing.Pool for parallel execution across multiple processes
review_pmap_wrapper_function: review the _wrapped_func helper that unpacks function arguments and handles progress updates
